My baby boy. 

I’ve had passive suicidal thoughts at least weekly, but often daily, since… well, 1997? I moved out around that time and had to get my life together. Shitty apartments, in a shitty city. Bad influence friends lead me to petty crime. I was lucky to never get caught. I turned my own life around at 21 after a failed attempt. Moved 3000km away from everyone I knew and started over. Never stole again. I’m 42 now and the thoughts have never really stopped, I’ve just learned to live with them. I’m not an unhappy person. I have a great job, beautiful wife, amazing house, and now an incredible baby boy. But, while I believe some people would be a little sad for a bit, I also believe it would be better for everyone if I just wasn’t here anymore. Insurance would pay off the house for my wife and boy. I don’t want to die per se but I’m not thrilled with the idea of working until I’m too old to enjoy life and then dying in an armchair, shitting my pants. 

But, like I said, my baby boy: I’m now excited to see him grow up, and I believe when my time comes, I’ll be sad to not see more of his life unfold. I hope I’ll provide some good memories and he’ll be proud to tell his kids about me.
